spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Origins of All Divine Functions

---

**¶1:** The origin of every influx of good into the soul is the Divine Love itself, the supreme source of all wisdoms; since all [GAP-1: influxes of good] are bestowed by the power of Divine Love alone.

**¶2:** The origin of every benediction and every elevation of the mind toward the Divine is the Divine Truth proceeding from Love — the first operation of the Divine into created spiritual life.

**¶3:** Also, [GAP-2: the] origin [GAP-3: of] every true interior perception of what is good and wise is the mediating Divine Influence that governs the illuminated region within the natural mind — the ruling principle of the glorified interior domain that lies within the external state of life, [GAP-4: proceeding from the authority] of the governing source of all wisdoms.

**¶4:** The origin of [GAP-5: all glorification and] every true acknowledgment of the Divine is the Divine Good beloved of all wisdoms, who is glorified in return.

**¶5:** The origin of all [GAP-6: who seek and reclaim scattered affections] and who pursue them is the primordial celestial will — [GAP-7: the first spiritual human.]

**¶6:** [GAP-8: The origin] of all who combat falsity and evil is [GAP-9: the] vivifying [GAP-10: Divine Truth], the source of all spiritual life, who has ordered his five derived faculties of spiritual perception each into its proper domain.

**¶7:** The origin of all who construct and order the interior structures of the regenerating mind is the Divine Wisdom that organizes all understanding into coherent form, which is glorified.

**¶8:** Also, the first of all who sustain and bear the fullness of the Divine within the soul is the upholding column of Divine Truth [GAP-11: that supports all spiritual order] [GAP-12: from the inmost to the outmost.]

**¶9:** The origin of [GAP-13: all] who liberate the mind from falsity and evil [GAP-14: is the Divine Truth in its radiant saving power]; that is, the one who liberates, as he frees whoever belongs [GAP-15: to the Divine] through his truths.

**¶10:** The origin of every pure perception of truth proceeding from good is the uncorrupted celestial Wisdom — truth in its pristine, virginal form [GAP-16: .]

**¶11:** The origin of all [the highest] and most glorified states of the regenerate soul [GAP-17: and of every illuminated perception] is the Divine Enlightenment of the understanding; which is the awakener of those who lie in spiritual dormancy, the gatherer into unity of those whose affections and truths have been dispersed and scattered.

---

### Translator's Note

The entire chapter is a catalogue of *first principles*: each paragraph names the Divine source from which a specific faculty of the regenerating mind descends. Read spiritually, these are not separate gods but distinct operations of the one Divine flowing into the human mind — Love as origin, Truth as proceeding form, Mediation as accommodation to the natural degree, Combat as temptation-resistance, Building as the ordering of understanding, Sustaining as the upholding of states, Deliverance as liberation from falsity, Pure Wisdom as uncorrupted perception, and Enlightened Understanding as the awakener that gathers all scattered goods and truths back into the unity of the regenerate will.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The beginning of every good grace is the great Father of the [ligh]ts; since [a]ll [graces] are given by his hand.
The beginning of each blessing and every prayer is the Mother of [L]ife, the first Holy Spirit.
Also, [the] beginning [of] every good [co]unsel is the T[h/i]rd Am[bassad]or, the king of the glorious realm that lies in this [wo]rld, [the image] of the King of the lights.
The beginning of [all glory and] each [hono]ur (?) is the Beloved of the Lights, who is honour[ed.]
The beginning of all [the trappers] and hunters is the First [Man]
[The beginning] of all fighters is [the] Living [Spirit], the Father of Life, who has distribu[ted about] his five sons from place to place.
The beginning of all the archit[e]cts and builders is the Great Builder, who is glorious.
Also, the first of all the porters of the gr[e]a[t]ness is the Pillar of Glory [the Perfect Man] [ ... ]
The beginning of [all] the deliverers [is Jesus the Splendour]; or the one who delivers, as he frees whoever belongs [to him] from his words.
The beginning of every wisdom of truth is the Virgin of Light, [.]
The beginning of all [the great]est honoured ones [and of all knowledge] is the Light Mind; who is the awakene[r of they] who sleep, the gatherer in of the ones who are sc[att]ered.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "all influxes of good are bestowed," and "graces" is the correct Kephalaia natural-plane term for influxes of good from the Father of Lights; the word also echoes "every good grace" in the same sentence.
The definite article is required before "beginning" to match the formulaic pattern "the beginning of every..." used throughout the chapter.
The preposition "of" is required to complete the formulaic phrase "the beginning of every good counsel," matching the pattern used in every other paragraph.

The spiritual reading says "proceeding from the authority of the governing source"; in the Kephalaia, the Third Ambassador is regularly identified as "the image" of the Father of Lights, expressing his delegated authority in natural-plane terms.

The spiritual reading says "all glorification and every true acknowledgment"; "all glory and each honour" pairs the two terms naturally in Kephalaia register, matching the Beloved of the Lights' role as the glorified one.

The spiritual reading says "who seek and reclaim scattered affections"; "trappers" correctly pairs with "hunters" in Kephalaia vocabulary and corresponds to the First Man's role of capturing and reclaiming scattered light particles.

The spiritual reading says "the first spiritual human"; "First Man" (Primal Man / Ohrmazd) is the standard Manichaean divine figure associated with trapping and hunting, whose sons were the first to combat darkness.
The spiritual reading says "The origin"; every paragraph in this chapter opens with the formula "The beginning of all..." and this paragraph must follow the same pattern.
The definite article is required before "Living Spirit," the standard Manichaean name for this divine figure.

The spiritual reading says "vivifying Divine Truth"; in Manichaean cosmology the "Living Spirit" is the divine figure who combats darkness and orders creation through his five sons — the exact natural-plane correspondent.

The spiritual reading says "that supports all spiritual order"; in the Kephalaia, the Pillar of Glory's standard epithet is "the Perfect Man," which in Swedenborgian terms corresponds to the Maximus Homo (Grand Man) whose perfect human form upholds all spiritual order.
The spiritual reading confirms "all" before "who liberate the mind from falsity," matching the chapter's consistent pattern of "all the [practitioners]."

The spiritual reading says "is the Divine Truth in its radiant saving power"; Jesus the Splendour is the standard Manichaean divine figure of salvation and deliverance, perfectly corresponding to the liberating function described here.

The spiritual reading says "whoever belongs to the Divine"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, "to him" refers back to Jesus the Splendour as the divine deliverer, expressing belonging to the Divine in personal terms.

The spiritual reading says "and of every illuminated perception"; in Kephalaia register, "knowledge" (gnosis) is the standard term for the illuminated perception that the Light Mind (Nous) bestows as the awakener and gatherer of the scattered.
